about: A1: Grenlock Clan nested sub-quests were locked behind their own parent

entries.where_sql: ID BETWEEN 21096 AND 21099 AND Name = 'Siv''s Spirit'
entries.why: Siv's Spirit needed Grenlock Clan FINISHED, but Grenlock Clan step 2 waits for Siv's Spirit to be finished (deadlock, whole RM/SM/BD epic locked); period: 'This is the second part in a nested quest. You must start the Grenlock Clan quest first' (Allakhazam Siv's Spirit) - now offered only while Grenlock Clan is in progress (OnlyDuring)

entries.where_sql: ID BETWEEN 21017 AND 21020 AND Name = 'Coplin''s Spirit'
entries.why: Coplin's Spirit needed Grenlock Clan FINISHED (deadlock with Grenlock Clan step 2); period: 'After completing the first part of the Grenlock crest quest and reaching level 20, go back and speak to Anrid' (Allakhazam Coplin's Spirit) - the first part is Siv's Spirit
